name: mind-map
description: Mind maps from an outline, with SVG, PDF and OPML downloads.

interface.longDescription:
Zovo Mind Map turns an outline or a plan into a clean mind map you can print or download. Type or paste your topics, one per line with 2 spaces of indent per level, or describe them in the chat, and it lays out up to 300 topics on 6 levels with no overlapping boxes and text wrapped inside each box.

Pick a layout: a balanced map with branches on both sides of the centre topic, a tree that grows to the right, or a top-down hierarchy like an org chart. Pick one of four colour themes: classic, ocean, forest or mono for black and white printing.

Downloads are a vector SVG, a vector PDF (sized to fit the map, or scaled to one Letter or A4 page) and an OPML file that outline and mind map apps can import. The interactive map lets you pan, zoom, fold and unfold branches, edit a topic and redraw, and save a PNG where the chat app allows downloads from the map.

If the outline has a problem, such as tabs mixed with spaces or a line that skips a level, you get the line number and the fix. You can also turn a nested map back into an indented or Markdown outline.

Good for brainstorms, study notes, project plans, meeting notes, essay outlines and team structures.

Limitations: up to 300 topics, 6 levels and 120 characters per topic. Topics are plain text; images, links, notes and cross-links are not drawn. The PDF font covers Latin, Greek and Cyrillic; Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji show as ? in the PDF, and the SVG keeps them. Maps are not saved, so download the files to keep them.
defaultPrompt: Mind map of Product launch: Marketing (Social posts, Email), Sales (Partner deals, Pricing), Product (Beta, Docs)
Top-down mind map with CEO at the centre: CTO (Web, Mobile) and CFO (Finance, Legal)
Mind map 'Trip to Japan' on one A4 page: Tokyo (Shibuya, Asakusa), Kyoto (Temples, Gion), Osaka (Food)

positive.description: Mind map from a topic list with downloads
positive.prompt: Make a mind map of Product launch: Marketing (Social posts, Email campaign, Press release), Sales (Partner deals, Pricing page), Product (Beta program, Help docs)
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_mind_map with title Product launch and the three branches as an indented outline. Reports 11 topics including the centre, 2 levels, 7 end topics and 0 overlapping boxes; branches Marketing (4), Sales (3), Product (3). The widget shows the map; SVG, PDF (one 831 x 258 pt page at 100%) and OPML downloads open.

positive.description: Mind map back to a Markdown outline
positive.prompt: Turn this mind map into Markdown bullets: centre Study plan; Biology with Cells and Genetics; Chemistry with Bonds and Acids
positive.expected_behavior: Calls outline_from_mind_map with title Study plan, the two branches as nested nodes and format markdown. Returns 7 topics, 2 levels below the centre and a 7-line outline starting '- Study plan', then '  - Biology', '    - Cells', with outline and OPML downloads.

positive.prompt: Top-down mind map with CEO at the centre: CTO (Web, Mobile) and CFO (Finance, Legal)
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_mind_map with CEO as the title, CTO and CFO with their children, and layout org-down. Reports 7 topics, 2 levels, 4 end topics and 0 overlapping boxes; the map is 304 x 244 pt and CEO sits above CTO and CFO.

positive.description: One A4 page with a colour theme
positive.prompt: Mind map 'Trip to Japan' on one A4 page, ocean theme: Tokyo (Shibuya, Asakusa), Kyoto (Temples, Gion), Osaka (Food, Castle), Budget (Flights, Hotels)
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_mind_map with page_size a4 and theme ocean. Reports 13 topics, 8 end topics and 0 overlapping boxes. The PDF is one landscape A4 page of 841.89 x 595.28 pt at 100% scale, in blue tones.

positive.description: Indented outline into a right tree
positive.prompt: Make a right tree mind map titled Goals from this outline: - Revenue (- New clients, - Upsell), - Team (- Hiring, then - Two engineers under Hiring)
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_mind_map with title Goals, layout right-tree and an outline where Two engineers is under Hiring. Reports 7 topics, 3 levels, 3 end topics and 0 overlapping boxes; the map is 479 x 156 pt and grows to the right.

negative.description: Flowcharts with decisions are a different job. Expected: generate_mind_map is not called for a yes/no process diagram; the assistant answers without this plugin.
negative.prompt: Draw a flowchart of our refund process with a yes/no decision for orders over $100

negative.description: Reading an image of a mind map is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant says this plugin does not read pictures.
negative.prompt: Here is a photo of my whiteboard mind map, what does it say?

negative.description: A plain question about mind mapping needs no map. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant answers in text.
negative.prompt: What are the benefits of mind mapping for studying?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: mind maps from an indented outline or nested topics (up to 300 topics, 6 levels), three layouts, four themes, SVG, PDF and OPML downloads, an interactive map with fold, edit and PNG save, and an outline export.

pl-PL.subtitle: Mapy myśli z konspektu
pl-PL.description: Zovo Mind Map zamienia konspekt w czytelną mapę myśli do pobrania. Wpisz tematy, jeden w wierszu z wcięciem 2 spacji na poziom, a narzędzie rozmieści do 300 tematów na 6 poziomach bez nachodzących na siebie pól, z tekstem zawiniętym w każdym polu. Wybierz układ zrównoważony, drzewo w prawo albo hierarchię z góry na dół oraz jeden z czterech motywów kolorów. Pobierzesz wektorowy plik SVG, wektorowy PDF (dopasowany do mapy albo do jednej strony Letter lub A4) i plik OPML. Interaktywna mapa pozwala przesuwać, powiększać, zwijać gałęzie, edytować temat i zapisać PNG. Ograniczenia: do 300 tematów, 6 poziomów i 120 znaków na temat; mapy nie są zapisywane.

de-DE.subtitle: Mindmaps aus Ihrer Gliederung
de-DE.description: Zovo Mind Map macht aus einer Gliederung eine klare Mindmap zum Herunterladen. Geben Sie Themen ein, eines pro Zeile mit 2 Leerzeichen Einzug pro Ebene, und das Tool ordnet bis zu 300 Themen auf 6 Ebenen ohne überlappende Kästen an, mit umbrochenem Text in jedem Kasten. Wählen Sie ein ausgewogenes Layout, einen Baum nach rechts oder eine Hierarchie von oben nach unten sowie eines von vier Farbthemen. Downloads: Vektor-SVG, Vektor-PDF (passend zur Karte oder auf eine Letter- bzw. A4-Seite skaliert) und OPML. In der interaktiven Karte können Sie verschieben, zoomen, Zweige einklappen, ein Thema bearbeiten und ein PNG speichern. Grenzen: bis zu 300 Themen, 6 Ebenen und 120 Zeichen pro Thema; Karten werden nicht gespeichert.

es-ES.subtitle: Mapas mentales de tu esquema
es-ES.description: Zovo Mind Map convierte un esquema en un mapa mental claro que puedes descargar. Escribe los temas, uno por línea con 2 espacios de sangría por nivel, y la herramienta coloca hasta 300 temas en 6 niveles sin cuadros superpuestos y con el texto ajustado dentro de cada cuadro. Elige un diseño equilibrado, un árbol hacia la derecha o una jerarquía de arriba abajo, y uno de cuatro temas de color. Descargas: SVG vectorial, PDF vectorial (ajustado al mapa o a una página Letter o A4) y OPML. El mapa interactivo permite desplazar, ampliar, plegar ramas, editar un tema y guardar un PNG. Límites: hasta 300 temas, 6 niveles y 120 caracteres por tema; los mapas no se guardan.

fr-FR.subtitle: Cartes mentales d'un plan
fr-FR.description: Zovo Mind Map transforme un plan en une carte mentale claire à télécharger. Saisissez les sujets, un par ligne avec 2 espaces de retrait par niveau, et l'outil dispose jusqu'à 300 sujets sur 6 niveaux sans cases qui se chevauchent, avec le texte renvoyé à la ligne dans chaque case. Choisissez une disposition équilibrée, un arbre vers la droite ou une hiérarchie de haut en bas, et l'un des quatre thèmes de couleur. Téléchargements : SVG vectoriel, PDF vectoriel (à la taille de la carte ou sur une page Letter ou A4) et OPML. La carte interactive permet de déplacer, zoomer, replier les branches, modifier un sujet et enregistrer un PNG. Limites : jusqu'à 300 sujets, 6 niveaux et 120 caractères par sujet ; les cartes ne sont pas conservées.

ja-JP.subtitle: アウトラインからマインドマップ
ja-JP.description: Zovo Mind Map は、アウトラインを見やすいマインドマップに変換し、ダウンロードできるようにします。1行に1つのトピックを、階層ごとに2スペースの字下げで入力すると、最大300トピック・6階層を、ボックスが重ならないように配置し、文字はボックス内で折り返します。レイアウトは左右に広がるバランス型、右に伸びるツリー、上から下への階層型から、カラーテーマは4種類から選べます。ダウンロードはベクターSVG、ベクターPDF（マップに合わせたサイズ、またはLetter・A4の1ページ）、OPMLです。インタラクティブなマップでは、移動、拡大縮小、枝の折りたたみ、トピックの編集、PNG保存ができます。制限：最大300トピック、6階層、1トピック120文字まで。マップは保存されません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Mapas mentais do seu roteiro
pt-BR.description: O Zovo Mind Map transforma um roteiro em um mapa mental claro para baixar. Digite os tópicos, um por linha com 2 espaços de recuo por nível, e a ferramenta organiza até 300 tópicos em 6 níveis sem caixas sobrepostas, com o texto quebrado dentro de cada caixa. Escolha um layout equilibrado, uma árvore para a direita ou uma hierarquia de cima para baixo, e um de quatro temas de cores. Downloads: SVG vetorial, PDF vetorial (no tamanho do mapa ou em uma página Letter ou A4) e OPML. O mapa interativo permite mover, aproximar, recolher ramos, editar um tópico e salvar um PNG. Limites: até 300 tópicos, 6 níveis e 120 caracteres por tópico; os mapas não são salvos.
